name: After § 25
title: REPORT on the 2023 and 2024 Commission reports on Türkiye
part_text: 25a. Notes with deep concern the continued expulsion of foreign Christian residents under public order and national security pretexts; deeply regrets the Turkish Constitutional Court’s 2024 ruling upholding the expulsion of nine individuals for alleged missionary activities; is alarmed by the new wave of expulsions of foreign Christians that started in December 2024;
